$comment: Owner requests for the agent benchmark (tools/agent-eval.ts). preset: joints set before the case (pose.set units: metres and degrees, by a script). expect.pose: joints after the case (same units, tolerance 0.002 m / 0.6°); every joint not listed must be where the preset left it. expect.view: the browser's view afterwards. expect.asks: the agent must ask instead of changing anything. expect.says: patterns its final answer must contain (case-insensitive). expect.person: fields the person in the seat must have afterwards (scene.summary person), or null for nobody.

cases.prompt: Lower the monitor by another 2 cm.
Raise the seat 2 cm and tilt the monitor down 3 degrees.
Press the right pedal all the way down.
Put the backrest back to how it was in the photos.
How far is a median adult's eye from the main monitor screen?
Show me the operator's view in my browser (its code is {code}).
Put the small woman in the seat. Can she reach the pedals?

says: (short|not reach|cannot reach|do not reach|doesn't reach|don't reach)

cases.prompt: How far are the person's eyes from the main monitor, and is the screen in a comfortable gaze range?
Show the clay figure instead, and take the glasses off.
Seat the tall man and show me the view from his eyes in the browser {code}.
Take the person out of the seat.
